blocks.html: A fun-filled day awaits shoppers on March 27, Easter Sunday in select Robinsons Malls. The traditional Easter Egg Hunt will be held together with arts and crafts workshops and capped with a Magic show. More games and prizes await kiddie participants. Gate opens at 10 am in the following Robinsons Malls: Robinsons Metro East, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Las Pinas, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Dasmarinas, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Town Mall Los Banso and Summit Ridge Promenade. Admission is free. For more details call (02) 4617540.
